findings.message: Assessment states the patient is three days post-injection on January 2, 2026, but the subjective states the first injection is scheduled for January 5, 2026 and has not yet occurred.
findings.rationale: The two sections describe mutually exclusive timelines: an injection cannot both be scheduled for a future date and already have been performed three days prior on the same encounter date.
findings.suggested_tone_hint: Reconcile the injection timing so the subjective and assessment describe the same status.
